name: cloud-copilot
description: Minimal one-button demo that launches the local GitHub Copilot CLI and streams its response back to the browser over SSE.

scripts.cc:restart: pkill -f 'node server.js' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; (nohup npm start > server.log 2>&1 & disown); sleep 2; curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-8787}
